lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. Three words are asked of Brandon and all three still stand. One: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first, asked in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday. Two: take the level line's mend, yes or no, asked in Status 262. Three: take the third what-if, fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes, yes or no, asked in Status 263. The work goes on in any case and only the freeze waits.

The what-ifs before fresh eyes (decision 316). Two fresh reviewers of two families, each in its own machine, were started at 7:16 AM MT on the three what-ifs that are ready: summer's mound of sand leaving, fall's leaves at the landing, and fall's lit faces going out. Each got the main branch's look and the what-if of every 4K frame, with the fault named and none of my own findings. The first answered at 7:38 AM MT (stated by it, read whole here). The mound leaving: 6 for the film as it stands and 8 with the what-if, take it. The lit faces: 5 and 8, take it; its cost is that fall's base goes dark about half a second before the change. The leaves at the landing: 6 and 7, take it after one mend, since one leaf before the left gold foot reads as a flat piece cut from paper in frames 2162 and 2163, the same place and the same reading as in Status 268. It could not judge play at speed. The second answer is due by 8:20 AM MT. Nothing is ruled before it and nothing is merged without his word.

The sand sprinkle's what-if. Pushed at 7:15 AM MT on the what-if branch. Three frames are drawn at 4K as the masters draw them, by three helper machines after calibrations equal to the wanted value (measured by them): film frame 2072 before and after and frame 2096 after. The before of 2096 is drawing. Looked at here at own size: on the main branch the sprinkle left of the base ends in a bright comet with a ruled lower edge about 410 pixels long. In the what-if the ruled stroke is gone and a softer tongue of grains remains whose lower edge still keeps one direction, and both helpers read its tip as an arrow toward the base. The gain is real and small, and the what-if changes two guard stills of summer, since the sprinkle lies in both. It goes to the two reviewers together with the mound arriving, whose builder reports by 8:05 AM MT.

A fault seen again on the main branch. Film frame 2072 at 4K, in the film as it stands and in the what-if alike: inside the glass at the right some thirty yellow green squares with sharp corners, 15 to 45 pixels each, hang in the air above the lawn, and stacks of short pale level dashes stand in the tree's crown. Open item 289 named these squares in the shake into summer at frame 1408. They show in the shake out of summer too. A diagnosis is ordered and no edit. It belongs to one more round of looks if he asks for one.

The page's lost drawing (item 294). Its mender states that the Windows shader warning's mend is on its branch, and that on a hosted Windows machine with the installed Chrome the main branch's build wrote one console line in fall and one in winter and the branch's build wrote none. A third hosted run was ruled at 7:36 AM MT for its last head, with the new words and the lit mark, due by 8:50 AM MT. Its push is due by 8:10 AM MT, then a fresh critic of another family.

The render instructions. The second builder pushed the last of its first groups at 7:24 AM MT (head read here by a fetch). Stated by it and not run here: 1320 tests passed with 8 skipped and the engine equals the main branch's. It now joins the first builder's words. The first builder's guards are due by 9:30 AM MT. The merge stays held until both are joined, the hosted proof passes and a third cold reader says yes.
Other open work. The first press with sound (item 285): the trial's numbers by 9:00 AM MT. The slow spring picture: trials on a hosted Mac by 8:30 AM MT. All of it is unknown on a real graphics card.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code, after the mends above. The what-ifs, each shown before and after at 4K with the reviewers' words, none merged without his word. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 7:39 AM MT: 52 calls), no call since 10:47 PM MT Wednesday. No film render and no new preview video since Status 268.
phase 6: 59.84 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 59.84 h used of 12.00 h allowed
